name: Rakish Presence
body:
Your underhanded demeanor puts others on edge.

Prerequisite(s): sneak attack

Benefit(s): You gain a bonus on Intimidate checks equal to the number of sneak attack dice you possess. In addition whenever you demoralize a foe the duration of the shaken condition is increased by an additional round for every 4 character levels you possess.
